question: Of the options listed below, the speed of sound is highest in__________ at 25°C.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Aluminium__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sound is a longitudinal wave in which particles oscillate in direction of propagation of the wave. 
 
• The speed of sound is more in solids, followed by liquids and gases. 
 
• The speed also changes with the temperature. 
 
• The speed is given as 

V = sqrt (B)/(ρ )

 
• B is the bulk modulus, ρ is the density of the medium. 
 
• Solids and liquids have higher mass densities (r ) than gases. But the corresponding increase in both the modulus (B) of solids and liquids is much higher.
 
• This makes the speed of sound the highest in solid.
